title: Whether a prescription is an order or a suggestion
binding: a stored `intent` column that kernel/fhir.py copies into MedicationRequest.intent
source: The FHIR R4 published value set http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationrequest-intent, expanded through tx.fhir.org. This is where a prescription's certainty already lives, and it is why no certainty QUESTION was added to the prescription form: R4 distinguishes a `proposal`, which is a suggestion made by someone with no authority to make it happen, from an `order`, which is a demand and an authorisation. A medicine a machine suggested is a `proposal`; a medicine a prescriber ordered is an `order`. Inventing a verification status for a MedicationRequest would be inventing a field R4 does not have, when it already has this one.
